article_manifest.title: Mali: Russian army and Africa Corps decimate more than 200 head of cattle near Diéma
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: l'armée et l'Africa corps russe déciment plus de 200 têtes de bétail près de Diéma
article_manifest.summary: Mali: the army and the Russian Africa Corps decimate more than 200 head of cattle near Diéma In Mali, more than 200 cattle and sheep were killed on Wednesday 28 October by the Malian army and its Russian partners of the Africa Corps in Mangara, Dioumara commune, Diéma circle, in the Nioro region of the Sahel. Homes were also set on fire. This is the second similar incident in eight days .

article_manifest.title: Dem/DSMIL: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces on an authority visit to both structures
article_manifest.original_title: DEM/DSMIL : Le Chef d’État-Major Général des Armées en visite d’autorité au sein des deux structures
article_manifest.summary: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Elisée Jean DAO, made visits to the Directorate of Military Schools (dem) and the Directorate of Military Sports (DSMIL) on Tuesday, 27 October 2026. . These visits are part of his series of visits to the headquarters and service directorates of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), aimed at inquiring about their functioning and recalling the directions of the command.

article_manifest.title: San: Release of abducted teachers
article_manifest.summary: The three teachers kidnapped by armed men more than a week ago in the San educational animation center were released on Thursday, October 29, 2026. The information was confirmed by CAPE TOWN officials. According to the latter, this release was made possible thanks to the involvement of the local population, whom they thanked for their support.

article_manifest.title: DIRECTORATE OF MILITARY JUSTICE: seven cases scheduled for the correctional hearing
article_manifest.original_title: DIRECTION DE LA JUSTICE MILITAIRE : sept affaires inscrites au rôle de l’audience correctionnelle
article_manifest.summary: The Military Court of Bamako held, on Tuesday, October 27, 2026, a correctional hearing at its premises, located in Dar Salam. The session was chaired by Magistrate Assama DOLO, assisted by his fellow magistrates. In total, seven cases were on the list for this hearing.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Macina: The closing of Solidarity and Social Exclusion Month at the centre of a meeting
article_manifest.original_title: Macina : La clôture du mois de la Solidarité et de l’exclusion sociale au centre d’une rencontre
article_manifest.summary: Macina, October 29 (AMAP) The Prefect of Circle, Albaraka Ag Amarizag, chaired this Wednesday, in the conference room of his constituency in Macina, a meeting on the closing of the month of Solidarity and social exclusion, noted AMAP . It was in the presence of the deputy mayor, Mamadou Almamy Tangara, the sub-prefect of Kolongotomo, the FAMa coordinator, and the acting head of the local development and solidarity economy department, Mr.

article_manifest.title: Mali: General Amadou Haya Sanogo appointed as head of the Board of Directors of the National Office of Veterans Affairs
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Le général Amadou Haya Sanogo nommé à la tête du Conseil d’administration de l’Office national des anciens combattants
article_manifest.summary: A new institutional responsibility was entrusted to Lieutenant General Amadou Haya Sanogo. By Decree No. 2026-0648/PT-RM of 22 October 2026, the President of the Transition, Head of State, Army General Assimi Goïta, appointed him Chairman of the Board of Directors of the National Office of Former Combatants, Retired Military Members and War Victims of Mali (ONAC-M) .

article_manifest.title: Niger: Journalist Moussa Kaka 'Enforced Disappearance', Denounces Human Rights Watch
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : le journaliste Moussa Kaka est victime d’une « disparition forcée », dénonce Human Rights Watch
article_manifest.summary: Journalist Moussa Kaka, reported missing and then declared detained in Niger, is the victim of an "enforced disappearance", denounced Thursday the NGO Human Rights Watch (HRW) which demands that the authorities reveal his place of detention. Niger has been ruled since 2023 by a military regime resulting from a coup d 'état, regularly accused by NGOs of repression, including attacks on press freedom.

article_manifest.title: Algeria Starts Arrangements to Send Troops to Niger to Protect Energy Projects
article_manifest.original_title: الجزائر تبدأ ترتيبات إرسال قوات إلى النيجر لحماية مشروعات الطاقة
article_manifest.summary: Algeria begins arrangements to send troops to Niger to protect energy projects - Algerian forces will be stationed in the vicinity of the Kafra field north of Niger, where Cepax, Sonatrach and Sonadip are engaged in oil exploration, taking advantage of geographical proximity to provide air coverage and an effective supply line.

article_manifest.title: Mali War School: the 6th class is back in school
article_manifest.original_title: École de Guerre du Mali : la 6e promotion fait sa rentrée
article_manifest.summary: The Mali War School (EGM) launched, on Thursday, October 22, 2026, the academic activities of its 6th class in Badalabougou, Bamako. The ceremony was presided over by the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces, Major General Elisée Jean Dao, in the presence of the director of the establishment, Major General Oumar Dao, and several partners . The inaugural lesson was moderated by Mamadou Tièny Konaté, Second Vice-President of the Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Mali (CCIM).

article_manifest.title: Mali: Dozo hunters and jihadists clash for a village near Djenné
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: Chasseurs dozos et jihadistes s'affrontent pour un village près de Djenné
article_manifest.summary: In Mali, the village of Sounga, which belongs to the commune of Mougna, near Djenné in the Mopti region, continues to resist the jihadists of Jnim, linked to al-Qaeda. While the surrounding villages have bowed to the domination of the jihadists, Sounga refuses to submit, provoking violent clashes last week between the Jnim jihadists and the traditional Dozo hunters, who strive to protect the population in this part of the territory where the Malian army is not present.

article_manifest.original_title: Algeria prepares troop deployment in Niger to protect oil assets and expand influence

article_manifest.original_title: Coopération militaire: ouverture de la deuxième session de Comité mixte de suivi Burkina Faso-Egypte
article_manifest.summary: (Ouagadougou, October 27, 2026) – The Ministry of War and Patriotic Defence (MGDP) hosted, on October 27, 2026 in Ouagadougou, the opening ceremony of the second session of the Joint Monitoring Committee for Military and Technical Cooperation between the Arab Republic of Egypt and Burkina Faso Scheduled for two days, the work was opened by the Comrade Secretary General of the MGDP, Intendant Colonel-Major Yamba Léonard OUOBA.

article_manifest.title: Russia-Africa: Moscow says it is ready to help the continent against terrorism
article_manifest.original_title: Russie-Afrique : Moscou se dit prêt à aider le continent contre le terrorisme
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, Oct. 29 (AMAP) Russia is ready to help its African partners fight terrorism, drug trafficking and cross-border crime, Russian President Vladimir Putin said during a meeting with representatives of major African regional organizations, organized as part of exchanges between Moscow and institutions on the continent, according to the TASS news agency The Russian head of state reaffirmed his country's willingness to continue close coordination with the African Union on a wide range of foreign policy issues.

article_manifest.title: Bamako: twelve suspects arrested in three criminal cases
article_manifest.original_title: Bamako : douze suspects interpellés dans trois affaires criminelles
article_manifest.summary: Three police stations in Bamako, those of ACI 2000, Sébénikoro and Boulkassoumbougou, arrested twelve suspects in three separate criminal cases that occurred in October 2026. The first case dates back to October 14. The body of a 23-year-old man was discovered in a gutter .

article_manifest.title: Chad and Niger squabble over drone strike
article_manifest.original_title: Tchad et Niger se querellent autour d’une frappe de drone
article_manifest.summary: The diplomatic crisis that has just erupted between Niger and Chad since a Chadian drone strike in Niger on October 24, has highlighted the growing tensions between the two countries for several months, where Paris plays an amplifying role . But it is unlikely to grow beyond the exchange of bird names, given the importance of good neighbourly relations between the two countries, which share a wide border, populations, enemies and sustained exchanges .

article_manifest.title: Menaka: 54 bodies discovered in a...
article_manifest.summary: Menaka: 54 bodies discovered in a camp in Tagadeyat The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced, in a statement, the macabre discovery of 54 lifeless bodies about 35 kilometers south-east of Menaka. Nine survivors were also found and evacuated to the city. The first testimonies attribute these killings to the Islamic State in the Greater Sahara (EIGS).
